permissions.window.panel: to show the folder tree, with what your agents are doing in it, in a panel beside your panes

permissions.pane.cwd: to show the folder the pane you're working in is in, and follow you when you switch panes or cd

permissions.pane.list: to show what your agents are doing in every pane, not only the one you're in, by the names you gave your panes

permissions.fs.list: to show the names of the files and folders in it, and to read the names of the markers your agents' hooks leave in .foldertree folders (never what's in a file)

permissions.viewer.open: to open the file you click, or a new one ready to edit, in Tilefold's document viewer

permissions.fs.write: to add new files and folders, rename and move them, and move them to the Trash when you say so (never what's in a file: you edit in the document viewer)

permissions.page: to show the tree, what your agents are doing and the recent files in a window of its own
